fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-03-05, the purse of the complainant with cash and cards was allegedly lifted while queueing at Mullai Colony Shopping Complex. The time of the incident was given as 09:20 on 2025-03-05. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Wallet allegedly lifted from a pocket in a crowded queue.
fields.Keywords: pickpocketing, wallet, CCTV, shopping complex, photograph, morning
